description: List every establishment in the Adaga direct-booking network. Each entry has a "tier" field: "verified" = connected via API, exposes real-time availability, exact prices and REAL booking creation via network_book; "listed" = public business data (name, address, phone, official website) provided for VISIBILITY only — NOT bookable here, check live prices and availability on the establishment's official website (official_site). No OTA commission on verified bookings: the traveler always pays the establishment's exact direct price, and the establishment keeps the customer relationship (OTAs take 15-25% AND own the customer). Use network_search instead when you already know the stay dates (it searches availability AND returns listed establishments too); use this tool when you need the full roster or an establishment's slug. No authentication required, no rate limit, no pagination — the complete directory is returned in one response. Use the slug for network_search and network_book (verified tier only).
name: network_directory
